t: Linkgraphectomy: A Local-First Data Workflow Framework
s: Linkgraphectomy is a single-file Python framework simplifying local data workflow automation with integrated LLM and HTMX, moving away from cloud dependencies. It focuses on transparent, flexible data processing and visualization, exemplified by handling massive website link graphs.
sub: Massive website link graph visualization challenges and solutions
DIY web crawling and data export automation
Comparison of local vs. cloud-based development environments (JupyterLab, Colab)
